recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the core branch. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-27028; future wording changes to this extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-27028 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for R5 asking that the valueset-trusted-expansion extension clarify that its url value is the FHIR terminology server [base] endpoint, not a specific ValueSet/$expand request URL or a pre-computed expansion URL.
initial_application: Core commit ade907ca5b1bc08efb093bc524c5b00bdc7fa5ac explicitly listed FHIR-27028 in a vocab R5 batch and changed source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-trusted-expansion.xml to the approved comment text. The extension source was later removed from core by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0.
additional_context: Current core source searches find no valueset-trusted-expansion StructureDefinition source and only retain the URL's OID registration in source/oids.ini. The current FHIR Extension Pack file input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-trusted-expansion.xml contains the requested description, definition, and comment language requiring a FHIR terminology server endpoint/[base] URL. Zulip and Vocab minutes evidence align with the same endpoint interpretation.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The issue is audited as external-repo because the current owning artifact is outside this FHIR core checkout and already has the requested clarification.
